slides.title: Monday’s continuation setup
slides.subtitle: Earliest entry 13:45 GMT / 15:45 PARIS · Later confirmation required
slides.narration:
The US market opens at thirteen thirty GMT, fifteen thirty Paris. Our earliest entry is fifteen minutes later.

Wait for two completed five-minute candles, with overlapping ranges and both closes above the pivot. Mark the base high, B, and low, L. The stop goes two ticks below L.

A later candle must close above B. The formula caps the purchase price and preserves at least one-point-five R to the first target.

Then one limit IOC attempt within five minutes. Fresh ask above B, at or below the ceiling; last price at least one tick above B. A return to B cancels the signal.

47 seconds: native Gamma mechanism stages the protocol one condition at a time; this is a schematic, never historical price action.

slides.title: HPE: Two Scenarios, Only One Best Signal
slides.narration:
H P E has both a continuation path and a deep-pullback backup. The backup begins only after price touches the fifty-eight fifty to fifty-eight ninety zone. A later completed fifteen-minute candle must close above fifty-nine.

The purchase is capped at fifty-nine fifteen, with an initial stop at fifty-seven eighty. The fixed targets are sixty-two ten and sixty-four twenty. At the maximum purchase price, the gross reward-to-risk ratio to the first target is about two point one nine.

A pullback becomes a new thesis only when the decline is not explained by adverse company information. The recovery confirms demand; it does not erase delivery, margin, or valuation risk.

slides.title: DELL: AI Growth and Index Calendar
slides.narration:
Dell is the second intraday priority. Its September first release reported forty-seven billion dollars of fiscal second-quarter revenue, up fifty-eight percent year over year.

Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue was thirty-one point eight billion, and AI-optimized server revenue was sixteen point four billion, up one hundred percent. These are reported revenue figures, distinct from orders, backlog, or full-year guidance.

The additional S and P one hundred inclusion creates a separate calendar catalyst. Together, these facts explain why we prepare the name early. AI server growth is not the same thing as durable free cash flow.

Supply, customer concentration, shipment timing, and competitive pricing can change the revenue-to-profit conversion.

slides.title: Shared Risk: The Correlation Matrix
slides.narration:
This matrix measures how daily returns moved together over the stated common window. A value near plus one means stronger co-movement in that sample; a value near zero means little linear relationship there.

It does not mean that two businesses are independent, or that their next loss cannot happen together. Historical correlation can change quickly around a macro event.

That matters because buying H P E, Dell, and several semiconductor names can concentrate the same broad AI spending exposure.

slides.title: One AI Value Chain, Several Drivers
slides.narration:
The AI label connects several businesses, but the economics are different. Taiwan Semiconductor sits upstream in manufacturing. Soitec supplies specialized semiconductor materials, while Semtech has an optical connectivity catalyst. H P E, Dell, and NetApp give us systems and data infrastructure exposure.

Fortum brings a separate electricity contract with a much longer economic timeline. These arrows describe a value chain, not measured cash flows between these companies. They also do not prove that all the shares must rise together.

slides.title: Holding Through the Fed: Decide Before Entry
slides.narration:
Every position that could cross the Fed needs a recorded YES or NO before entry. With NO, Wednesday US submissions stop at 17:50 GMT, 19:50 Paris, and the position is out by 17:55 GMT, 19:55 Paris.

European intraday positions retain their 15:20 GMT, 17:20 Paris exit. With YES, the planned holding horizon remains, subject to exposure and combined-risk limits. If the choice is absent, no new position may cross the event.

Missing data does not create an automatic sale of an already-held position. That distinction keeps an incomplete trade sheet from silently changing the strategy during a headline-driven move.

slides.title: Index Announcement ≠ Guaranteed Imbalance
slides.narration:
An index announcement begins a chain of portfolio adjustments. Funds following the affected benchmarks may have to buy or sell, but the final market impact depends on weights, assets, existing positioning, and how execution is distributed through time.

Other traders can anticipate those flows. Opposing index changes can offset part of them. That is why we do not translate a confirmed addition into a guaranteed closing rally.

Our intraday plan still requires an exit at nine fifty in the evening Paris time.

slides.title: Continuation: Freeze the Base Before the Signal
slides.narration:
After price crosses the pivot, wait for two completed, consecutive five-minute candles. Their ranges must overlap and both closes must be above the pivot. Freeze the base high as B, the base low as L, and width W as B minus L.

The original stop is L minus two actual exchange ticks. A strictly later five-minute candle must close above B. The two candles that define the base cannot also be the confirmation candle.

Freezing the structure prevents the entry rule from moving with a rising quote. Monday’s tick size must come from the instrument, not an assumption that every share trades in one-cent increments.

slides.title: The Cap Protects the Available R-Multiple
slides.narration:
The first purchase ceiling is B plus one quarter of W, rounded down to the actual tick. When known resistance exists, first target T1 is one tick below it. Let S be the original stop.

The reward constraint gives a second ceiling: T1 plus one-point-five times S, divided by two-point-five. The permitted cap is the lower of these two ceilings. It must still be at least B plus one tick.

If that fails, the base cannot support a purchase. Confirmation can occur above the ceiling; it is the limit price, not the confirmation close, that stays capped.
slides.source: P < B + 1 Tick ⇒ No Buy Is Possible from This Base.

slides.title: One IOC Attempt Within Five Minutes
slides.narration:
After confirmation, the execution window is one five-minute interval. The ask must be strictly above B and at or below the ceiling. The last traded price must be at least one tick above B. Then make one limit IOC attempt only.

Abort before purchase if either ask or last returns to B or below, if the structural stop is touched, if the window expires, or if fixed T1 is reached before the buy. An unfilled IOC is not retried.

Any restart requires a new, complete base. The protocol records an unavailable setup rather than turning a late quote into a chase.

slides.title: R Outcomes Describe Position Management
slides.narration:
Position management starts from the average price actually paid. R is that average entry minus the original stop. Protect the quantity actually filled immediately. At the first target, sell half, rounded down to a whole share with a minimum of one.

Only after that entire tranche is effectively sold do we move the stop on the remainder to the average entry. Sell the balance at the second target.

slides.title: Time Is Part of Risk
slides.narration:
Time is part of the setup. US entries may begin at 13:45 GMT, 15:45 Paris; Europe may begin at 07:15 GMT, 09:15 Paris, once the required structure exists.

Normal entry cutoffs are 18:00 GMT, 20:00 Paris for the US and 14:00 GMT, 16:00 Paris for Europe.

Intraday positions close by 19:50 GMT, 21:50 Paris in the US, and 15:20 GMT, 17:20 Paris in Europe, subject to the earlier Fed NO deadline.

After sixty minutes, exit a position that has never reached plus one-half R and remains at or below entry. A losing intraday position is never relabelled a swing merely to defer a decision.

slides.title: Fortum: A Long Contract, a Deferred Impact
slides.narration:
Fortum offers a different kind of catalyst. The September ninth announcement describes a twenty-two-year nuclear power purchase agreement with Google. Delivery starts at reduced capacity in twenty twenty-eight and can reach fifty percent of Loviisa’s capacity for twenty thirty through twenty forty-nine.

That supports future economic visibility, not an immediate twenty twenty-six earnings uplift. The company’s estimate of an eventual improvement in return on net assets is conditional and forward-looking. There is also investment work associated with the plant’s extended life.

slides.title: Fortum and Neste: Two Different Economics
slides.narration:
Fortum and Neste both belong in an energy-related conversation, but they are not a single trade. Fortum’s catalyst is a long-term electricity contract. Neste’s near-term evidence concerns renewable-product margins and operating performance, with future capacity execution still ahead.

A change in power prices, a change in feedstock prices, and a change in regulation can affect these businesses in very different ways. The useful comparison is therefore mechanism by mechanism.
